It also brings meaningful upgrades to serving APIs, profiling & benchmarking, and overall stability. Please check our latest [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02204) for architecture design and performance results.\n- [2026/01] We released [0.12.0rc1](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/releases/tag/v0.12.0rc1) - a major RC milestone focused on maturing the diffusion stack, strengthening OpenAI-compatible serving, expanding omni-model coverage, and improving stability across platforms (GPU/NPU/ROCm).\n- [2025/11] vLLM community officially released [vllm-project/vllm-omni](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni) in order to support omni-modality models serving.\n\n---\n\n## About\n\n[vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) was originally designed to support large language models for text-based autoregressive generation tasks. vLLM-Omni is a framework that extends its support for omni-modality model inference and serving:\n\n- **Omni-modality**: Text, image, video, and audio data processing\n- **Non-autoregressive Architectures**: extend the AR support of vLLM to Diffusion Transformers (DiT) and other parallel generation models\n- **Heterogeneous outputs**: from traditional text generation to multimodal outputs\n\n<p align=\"center\">\n  <picture>\n    <img alt=\"vllm-omni\" src=\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/refs/heads/main/docs/source/architecture/omni-modality-model-architecture.png\" width=55%>\n  </picture>\n</p>\n\nvLLM-Omni is fast with:\n\n- State-of-the-art AR support by leveraging efficient KV cache management from vLLM\n- Pipelined stage execution overlapping for high throughput performance\n- Fully disaggregation based on OmniConnector and dynamic resource allocation across stages\n\nvLLM-Omni is flexible and easy to use with:\n\n- Heterogeneous pipeline abstraction to manage complex model workflows\n- Seamless integration with popular Hugging Face models\n- Tensor, pipeline, data and expert parallelism support for distributed inference\n- Streaming outputs\n- OpenAI-compatible API server\n\nvLLM-Omni seamlessly supports most popular open-source models on HuggingFace, including:\n\n- Omni-modality models (e.g. Qwen-Omni)\n- Multi-modality generation models (e.g. Qwen-Image)\n\n## Getting Started\n\nVisit our [documentation](https://vllm-omni.readthedocs.io/en/latest/) to learn more.\n\n- [Installation](https://vllm-omni.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/installation/)\n- [Quickstart](https://vllm-omni.readthedocs.io/en/latest/getting_started/quickstart/)\n- [List of Supported Models](https://vllm-omni.readthedocs.io/en/latest/models/supported_models/)\n\n## Contributing\n\nWe welcome and value any contributions and collaborations.\nPlease check out [Contributing to vLLM-Omni](https://vllm-omni.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/) for how to get involved.\n\n## Citation\n\nIf you use vLLM-Omni for your research, please cite our [paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02204):\n\n```bibtex\n@article{yin2026vllmomni,\n  title={vLLM-Omni: Fully Disaggregated Serving for Any-to-Any Multimodal Models},\n  author={Peiqi Yin, Jiangyun Zhu, Han Gao, Chenguang Zheng, Yongxiang Huang, Taichang Zhou, Ruirui Yang, Weizhi Liu, Weiqing Chen, Canlin Guo, Didan Deng, Zifeng Mo, Cong Wang, James Cheng, Roger Wang, Hongsheng Liu},\n  journal={arXiv preprint arXiv:2602.02204},\n  year={2026}\n}\n```\n\n## Join the Community\nFeel free to ask questions, provide feedbacks and discuss with fellow users of vLLM-Omni in `#sig-omni` slack channel at [slack.vllm.ai](https://slack.vllm.ai) or vLLM user forum at self.vae_scale_factor = 2 ** len(self.vae.temperal_downsample) if getattr(self, \"vae\", None) else 8\n        self.latent_channels = self.vae.config.z_dim if getattr(self, \"vae\", None) else 16\n        # QwenImage latents are turned into 2x2 patches and packed. Copied from diffusers.pipelines.qwenimage.pipeline_qwenimage.QwenImagePipeline._extract_masked_hidden\n    def _extract_masked_hidden(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, mask: torch.Tensor):\n        bool_mask = mask.bool()\n        valid_lengths = bool_mask.sum(dim=1)\n        selected = hidden_states[bool_mask]\n        split_result = torch.split(selected, valid_lengths.tolist(), dim=0)\n\n        return split_result\n\n    def _get_qwen_prompt_embeds(\n        self,\n        prompt: Union[str, List[str]] = None,\n        image: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n        device: Optional[torch.device] = None,\n        dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,\n    ):\n        device = device or self._execution_device\n        dtype = dtype or self.text_encoder.dtype\n\n        prompt = [prompt] if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt\n\n        template = self.prompt_template_encode\n        drop_idx = self.prompt_template_encode_start_idx\n        txt = [template.format(e) for e in prompt]\n\n        model_inputs = self.processor(\n            text=txt,\n            images=image,\n            padding=True,\n            return_tensors=\"pt\",\n        ).to(device)\n\n        outputs = self.text_encoder(\n            input_ids=model_inputs.input_ids,\n            attention_mask=model_inputs.attention_mask,\n            pixel_values=model_inputs.pixel_values,\n            image_grid_thw=model_inputs.image_grid_thw,\n            output_hidden_states=True,\n        )\n\n        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]\n        split_hidden_states = self._extract_masked_hidden(hidden_states, model_inputs.attention_mask)\n        split_hidden_states = [e[drop_idx:] for e in split_hidden_states]\n        attn_mask_list = [torch.ones(e.size(0), dtype=torch.long, device=e.device) for e in split_hidden_states]", "wall_time": "0.0511 seconds"}

time, call stack, and GPU utilization metrics.\n\n### Denoising Stage Profiling\n\nProfile the denoising stage with sampled timesteps (default: 5 steps after 1 warmup step):\n\n```bash\nsglang generate \\\n  --model-path Qwen/Qwen-Image \\\n  --prompt \"A Logo With Bold Large Text: SGL Diffusion\" \\\n  --seed 0 \\\n  --profile\n```\n\n**Parameters:**\n- `--profile`: Enable profiling for the denoising stage\n- `--num-profiled-timesteps N`: Number of timesteps to profile after warmup (default: 5)\n  - Smaller values reduce trace file size\n  - Example: `--num-profiled-timesteps 10` profiles 10 steps after 1 warmup step\n\n### Full Pipeline Profiling\n\nProfile all pipeline stages (text encoding, denoising, VAE decoding, etc.):\n\n```bash\nsglang generate \\\n  --model-path Qwen/Qwen-Image \\\n  --prompt \"A Logo With Bold Large Text: SGL Diffusion\" \\\n  --seed 0 \\\n  --profile \\\n  --profile-all-stages\n```\n\n**Parameters:**\n- `--profile-all-stages`: Used with `--profile`, profile all pipeline stages instead of just denoising\n\n### Output Location\n\nBy default, trace files are saved in the ./logs/ directory.\n\nThe exact output file path will be shown in the console output, for example:\n\n```bash\n[mm-dd hh:mm:ss] Saved profiler traces to: /sgl-workspace/sglang/logs/mocked_fake_id_for_offline_generate-5_steps-global-rank0.trace.json.gz\n```\n\n### View Traces\n\nLoad and visualize trace files at:\n- https://ui.perfetto.dev/ (recommended)\n- chrome://tracing (Chrome only)\n\nFor large trace files, reduce `--num-profiled-timesteps` or avoid using `--profile-all-stages`.\n\n\n### `--perf-dump-path` (Stage/Step Timing Dump)\n\nBesides profiler traces, you can also dump a lightweight JSON report that contains:\n- stage-level timing breakdown for the full pipeline\n- step-level timing breakdown for the denoising stage (per diffusion step)\n\nThis is useful to quickly identify which stage dominates end-to-end latency, and whether denoising steps have uniform runtimes (and if not, which step has an abnormal spike).\n\nThe dumped JSON contains a `denoise_steps_ms` field formatted as an array of objects, each with a `step` key (the step index) and a `duration_ms` key.\n\nExample:\n\n```bash\nsglang generate \\\n  --model-path <MODEL_PATH_OR_ID> \\\n  --prompt \"<PROMPT>\" \\\n  --perf-dump-path perf.json\n```\n\n## Nsight Systems\n\nNsight Systems provides low-level CUDA profiling with kernel details, register usage, and memory access patterns.\n\n### Installation\n\nSee the [SGLang profiling guide](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/docs/developer_guide/benchmark_and_profiling.md#profile-with-nsight) for installation instructions.\n\n### Basic Profiling\n\nProfile the entire pipeline execution:\n\n```bash\nnsys profile \\\n  --trace-fork-before-exec=true \\\n  --cuda-graph-trace=node \\\n  --force-overwrite=true \\\n  -o QwenImage \\\n  sglang generate \\\n    --model-path Qwen/Qwen-Image \\\n    --prompt \"A Logo With Bold Large Text: SGL Diffusion\" \\\n    --seed 0\n```\n\n### Targeted Stage Profiling\n\nUse `--delay` and `--duration` to capture specific stages and reduce file size:\n\n```bash\nnsys profile \\\n  --trace-fork-before-exec=true \\\n  --cuda-graph-trace=node \\\n  --force-overwrite=true \\\n  --delay 10 \\\n  --duration 30 \\\n  -o QwenImage_denoising \\\n  sglang generate \\\n    --model-path Qwen/Qwen-Image \\\n    --prompt \"A Logo With Bold Large Text: SGL Diffusion\" \\\n    --seed 0\n```\n\n**Parameters:**\n- `--delay N`: Wait N seconds before starting capture (skip initialization overhead)\n- `--duration N`: Capture for N seconds (focus on specific stages)\n- `--force-overwrite`: Overwrite existing output files\n\n## Notes\n\n- **Reduce trace size**: Use `--num-profiled-timesteps` with smaller values or `--delay`/`--duration` with Nsight Systems\n- **Stage-specific analysis**: Use `--profile` alone for denoising torch.Generator(device=device) if device.type == \"cuda\" else torch.Generator()\n+    generator.manual_seed(args.seed)\n+\n+    images = sorted([p for p in input_dir.iterdir() if p.suffix.lower() in {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}])\n+    if not images:\n+        raise SystemExit(f\"No images found under: {input_dir}\")\n+\n+    # Warmup\n+    for idx in range(min(args.warmup, len(images))):\n+        img = _load_image(images[idx])\n+        _ = pipe(\n+            image=img,\n+            prompt=args.prompt,\n+            negative_prompt=args.negative_prompt,\n+            num_inference_steps=args.steps,\n+            true_cfg_scale=args.true_cfg_scale,\n+            height=args.height,\n+            width=args.width,\n+            generator=generator,\n+            output_type=\"pil\",\n+        )\n+\n+    results: list[RunResult] = []\n+    for path in images:\n+        img = _load_image(path)\n+        if device.type == \"cuda\":\n+            torch.cuda.synchronize()\n+        t0 = time.perf_counter()\n+        out = pipe(\n+            image=img,\n+            prompt=args.prompt,\n+            negative_prompt=args.negative_prompt,\n+            num_inference_steps=args.steps,\n+            true_cfg_scale=args.true_cfg_scale,\n+            height=args.height,\n+            width=args.width,\n+            generator=generator,\n+            output_type=\"pil\",\n+        )\n+        if device.type == \"cuda\":\n+            torch.cuda.synchronize()\n+        dt = time.perf_counter() - t0\n+\n+        out_path = output_dir / f\"{path.stem}_out.png\"\n+        out.images[0].save(out_path)\n+        results.append(\n+            RunResult(\n+                file=path.name,\n+                seconds=float(dt),\n+                height=int(args.height),\n+                width=int(args.width),\n+                steps=int(args.steps),\n+                cuda=device.type == \"cuda\",\n+            )\n+        )\n+        print(f\"{path.name}: {dt:.3f}s\")\n+\n+    summary = {\n+        \"model_id\": args.model_id,\n+        \"quantized_transformer\": args.quantized_transformer,\n+        \"lora\": args.lora,\n+ \"cpu_offload\": bool(args.cpu_offload),\n+        \"seed\": args.seed,\n+        \"true_cfg_scale\": args.true_cfg_scale,\n+        \"results\": [asdict(r) for r in results],\n+ It is designed to be modular and extensible, allowing users to easily add new models and optimizations.\n\n## Key Features\n\nSGLang Diffusion has the following features:\n  - Broad model support: Wan series, FastWan series, Hunyuan, Qwen-Image, Qwen-Image-Edit, Flux, Z-Image, GLM-Image\n  - Fast inference speed: enpowered by highly optimized kernel from sgl-kernel and efficient scheduler loop\n  - Ease of use: OpenAI-compatible api, CLI, and python sdk support\n  - Multi-platform support: NVIDIA GPUs (H100, H200, A100, B200, 4090) and AMD GPUs (MI300X, MI325X)\n\n### AMD/ROCm Support\n\nSGLang Diffusion supports AMD Instinct GPUs through ROCm. On AMD platforms, we use the Triton attention backend and leverage AITER kernels for optimized layernorm and other operations. See the [ROCm installation guide](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/tree/main/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/docs/install_rocm.md) for setup instructions.\n\n## Getting Started\n\n```bash\nuv pip install 'sglang[diffusion]' --prerelease=allow\n```\n\nFor more installation methods (e.g. pypi, uv, docker), check [install.md](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/tree/main/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/docs/install.md). ROCm/AMD users should follow the [ROCm quickstart](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/tree/main/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/docs/install_rocm.md) that includes the additional kernel builds and attention backend settings we validated on MI300X.\n\n\n## Inference\n\nHere's a minimal example to generate a video using the default settings:\n\n```python\nfrom sglang.multimodal_gen import DiffGenerator\n\ndef main():\n    # Create a diff generator from a pre-trained model\n    generator = DiffGenerator.from_pretrained(\n        model_path=\"Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers\",\n        num_gpus=1,  # Adjust based on your hardware\n    )\n\n    # Generate the video\n    video = generator.generate(\n        sampling_params_kwargs=dict(\n            prompt=\"A curious raccoon peers through a vibrant field of yellow sunflowers, its eyes wide with interest.\",\n            return_frames=True,  # Also return frames from this call (defaults to False)\n            output_path=\"my_videos/\",  # Controls where videos are saved\n            save_output=True\n        )\n    )\n\nif __name__ == '__main__':\n    main()\n```\n\nOr, more simply, with the CLI:\n\n```bash\nsglang generate --model-path Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers \\\n    --text-encoder-cpu-offload --pin-cpu-memory \\\n    --prompt \"A curious raccoon\" \\\n    --save-output\n```\n\n### LoRA support\n\nApply LoRA adapters via `--lora-path`:\n\n```bash\nsglang generate \\\n  --model-path Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 \\\n  --lora-path prithivMLmods/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Anime \\\n  --prompt \"Transform into anime.\" \\\n  --image-path \"https://huggingface.co/datasets/huggingface/documentation-images/resolve/main/diffusers/cat.png\" \\\n  --save-output\n```\n\nFor more usage examples (e.g. OpenAI compatible API, server mode), check [cli.md](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/tree/main/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/docs/cli.md).\n\n## Contributing\n\nAll contributions are welcome. (default: `default`).\n- `--num-gpus {NUM_GPUS}`: Number of GPUs to use\n- `--tp-size {TP_SIZE}`: Tensor parallelism size (only for the encoder; should not be larger than 1 if text encoder offload is enabled, as layer-wise offload plus prefetch is faster)\n- `--sp-degree {SP_SIZE}`: Sequence parallelism size (typically should match the number of GPUs)\n- `--ulysses-degree {ULYSSES_DEGREE}`: The degree of DeepSpeed-Ulysses-style SP in USP\n- `--ring-degree {RING_DEGREE}`: The degree of ring attention-style SP in USP\n- `--attention-backend {BACKEND}`: Attention backend to use. For SGLang-native pipelines use `fa`, `torch_sdpa`, `sage_attn`, etc. For diffusers pipelines use diffusers backend names like `flash`, `_flash_3_hub`, `sage`, `xformers`.\n- `--attention-backend-config {CONFIG}`: Configuration for the attention backend. Can be a JSON string (e.g., '{\"k\": \"v\"}'), a path to a JSON/YAML file, or key=value pairs (e.g., \"k=v,k2=v2\").\n- `--cache-dit-config {PATH}`: Path to a Cache-DiT YAML/JSON config (diffusers backend only)\n- `--dit-precision {DTYPE}`: Precision for the DiT model (currently supports fp32, fp16, and bf16).\n\n\n### Sampling Parameters\n\n- `--prompt {PROMPT}`: Text description for the video you want to generate\n- `--num-inference-steps {STEPS}`: Number of denoising steps\n- `--negative-prompt {PROMPT}`: Negative prompt to guide generation away from certain concepts\n- `--seed {SEED}`: Random seed for reproducible generation\n\n\n#### Image/Video Configuration\n\n- `--height {HEIGHT}`: Height of the generated output\n- `--width {WIDTH}`: Width of the generated output\n- `--num-frames {NUM_FRAMES}`: Number of frames to generate\n- `--fps {FPS}`: Frames per second for the saved output, if this is a video-generation task\n\n\n#### Output Options\n\n- `--output-path {PATH}`: Directory to save the generated video\n- `--save-output`: Whether to save the image/video to disk\n- `--return-frames`: Whether to return the raw frames\n\n### Using Configuration Files\n\nInstead of specifying all parameters on the command line, you can use a configuration file:\n\n```bash\nsglang generate --config {CONFIG_FILE_PATH}\n```\n\nThe configuration file should be in JSON or YAML format with the same parameter names as the CLI options. Command-line arguments take precedence over settings in the configuration file, allowing you to override specific values while keeping the rest from the configuration file.\n\nExample configuration file (config.json):\n\n```json\n{\n    \"model_path\": \"FastVideo/FastHunyuan-diffusers\",\n    \"prompt\": \"A beautiful woman in a red dress walking down a street\",\n    \"output_path\": \"outputs/\",\n    \"num_gpus\": 2,\n    \"sp_size\": 2,\n    \"tp_size\": 1,\n    \"num_frames\": 45,\n    \"height\": 720,\n    \"width\": 1280,\n    \"num_inference_steps\": 6,\n    \"seed\": 1024,\n    \"fps\": 24,\n    \"precision\": \"bf16\",\n    \"vae_precision\": \"fp16\",\n    \"vae_tiling\": true,\n    \"vae_sp\": true,\n    \"vae_config\": {\n        \"load_encoder\": false,\n        \"load_decoder\": true,\n        \"tile_sample_min_height\": 256,\n        \"tile_sample_min_width\": 256\n    },\n    \"text_encoder_precisions\": [\n        \"fp16\",\n        \"fp16\"\n    ],\n    \"mask_strategy_file_path\": null,\n    \"enable_torch_compile\": false\n}\n```\n\nOr using YAML format (config.yaml):\n\n```yaml\nmodel_path: \"FastVideo/FastHunyuan-diffusers\"\nprompt: \"A beautiful woman in a red dress walking down a street\"\noutput_path: \"outputs/\"\nnum_gpus: 2\nsp_size: 2\ntp_size: 1\nnum_frames: 45\nheight: 720\nwidth: 1280\nnum_inference_steps: 6\nseed: 1024\nfps: 24\nprecision: \"bf16\"\nvae_precision: \"fp16\"\nvae_tiling: true\nvae_sp: true\nvae_config:\n  load_encoder: false\n  load_decoder: true\n  tile_sample_min_height: 256\n  tile_sample_min_width: 256\ntext_encoder_precisions:\n  - \"fp16\"\n  - \"fp16\"\nmask_strategy_file_path: null\nenable_torch_compile: false\n```\n\n\nTo see all the options, you can use the `--help` flag:\n\n```bash\nsglang generate --help\n```\n\n## Serve\n\nLaunch the SGLang diffusion HTTP server and interact with it using the OpenAI SDK and curl.\n\n### Start the server\n\nUse the following command to launch the server:\n\n```bash\nSERVER_ARGS=(\n  --model-path Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers\n  --text-encoder-cpu-offload\n  --pin-cpu-memory\n  --num-gpus 4\n  --ulysses-degree=2\n  --ring-degree=2\n)\n\nsglang serve \"${SERVER_ARGS[@]}\"\n```\n\n- **--model-path**: Which model to load. The example uses `Wan-AI/Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers`.\n- **--port**: HTTP port to listen on (the default here is `30010`).\n\nFor detailed API usage, including Image, Video Generation and LoRA management, please refer to the [OpenAI API Documentation](openai_api.md).\n\n### Cloud Storage Support\n\nSGLang diffusion supports automatically uploading generated images and videos to S3-compatible cloud storage (e.g., AWS S3, MinIO, Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent Cloud COS).\n\nWhen enabled, the server follows a **Generate -> Upload -> Delete** workflow:\n1. The artifact is generated to a temporary local file.\n2. The file is immediately uploaded to the configured S3 bucket in a background thread.\n3. Upon successful upload, the local file is deleted.\n4. The API response returns the public URL of the uploaded object.\n\n#### Configuration\n\nCloud storage is enabled via environment variables. Note that `boto3` must be installed separately (`pip install boto3`) to use this feature.\n\n```bash\n# Enable S3 storage\nexport SGLANG_CLOUD_STORAGE_TYPE=s3\nexport SGLANG_S3_BUCKET_NAME=my-bucket\nexport SGLANG_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=your-access-key\nexport SGLANG_S3_SECRET_[REDACTED]\n\n# Optional: Custom endpoint for MinIO/OSS/COS\nexport SGLANG_S3_ENDPOINT_URL=https://minio.example.com\n```\n\nSee [Environment Variables Documentation](environment_variables.md) for more details.\n\n## Generate\n\nRun a one-off generation task without launching a persistent server.\n\nTo use it, pass both server arguments and sampling parameters in one command, after the `generate` subcommand, for example:\n\n```bash\nSERVER_ARGS=(\n  --model-path Wan-AI/Wan2.2-T2V-A14B-Diffusers\n  --text-encoder-cpu-offload\n  --pin-cpu-memory\n  --num-gpus 4\n  --ulysses-degree=2\n  --ring-degree=2\n)\n\nSAMPLING_ARGS=(\n  --prompt \"A curious raccoon\"\n  --save-output\n  --output-path outputs\n  --output-file-name \"A curious raccoon.mp4\"\n)\n\nsglang generate \"${SERVER_ARGS[@]}\" \"${SAMPLING_ARGS[@]}\"\n\n# Or, users can set `SGLANG_CACHE_DIT_ENABLED` env as `true` to enable cache acceleration\nSGLANG_CACHE_DIT_ENABLED=true sglang generate \"${SERVER_ARGS[@]}\" \"${SAMPLING_ARGS[@]}\"\n```\n\nOnce the generation task has finished, the server will shut down automatically.\n\n> [!NOTE]\n> The HTTP server-related arguments are ignored in this subcommand.", "wall_time": "0.0507 seconds"}

Synchronize all ranks after download completes\n        if dist.is_initialized():\n            dist.barrier()\n\n        # Non-rank-0 workers now download (will hit cache since rank 0 completed)\n        if rank != 0:\n            lora_local_path = maybe_download_lora(lora_path)\n\n        raw_state_dict = load_file(lora_local_path)\n        lora_state_dict = normalize_lora_state_dict(raw_state_dict, logger=logger)\n\n        if lora_nickname in self.lora_adapters:\n            self.lora_adapters[lora_nickname].clear()\n\n        config = self.server_args.pipeline_config.dit_config.arch_config\n\n        param_names_mapping_fn = get_param_names_mapping(\n            config.param_names_mapping\n            or self.modules[\"transformer\"].param_names_mapping\n        )\n        lora_param_names_mapping_fn = get_param_names_mapping(\n            config.lora_param_names_mapping\n            or self.modules[\"transformer\"].lora_param_names_mapping\n        )\n\n        to_merge_params: defaultdict[Hashable, dict[Any, Any]] = defaultdict(dict)\n        for name, weight in lora_state_dict.items():\n            name = name.replace(\"diffusion_model.\", \"\")\n            name = name.replace(\".weight\", \"\")\n            # misc-format -> HF-format\n            name, _, _ = lora_param_names_mapping_fn(name)\n            # HF-format (LoRA) -> SGLang-dit-format\n            target_name, merge_index, num_params_to_merge = param_names_mapping_fn(name)\n            # for fuse B(out_dim, r) @ A(r, in_dim) -> (N, out_dim, r) @ (N, r, in_dim)\n            # see param mapping in HunyuanVideoArchConfig\n            if merge_index is not None:\n                to_merge_params[target_name][merge_index] = weight\n                if len(to_merge_params[target_name]) == num_params_to_merge:\n                    sorted_tensors = [\n                        to_merge_params[target_name][i]\n                        for i in range(num_params_to_merge)\n                    ]\n                    # Use stack instead of cat because it needs to be compatible with TP.\n                    weight = torch.stack(sorted_tensors, dim=0)\n                    del to_merge_params[target_name]\n                else:\n                    continue\n\n            if target_name in self.lora_adapters[lora_nickname]:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f\"Dit target weight name {target_name} already exists in lora_adapters[{lora_nickname}]\"\n                )\n            self.lora_adapters[lora_nickname][target_name] = weight.to(self.device)\n        self.loaded_adapter_paths[lora_nickname] = lora_path\n        logger.info(\"Rank %d: loaded LoRA adapter %s\", rank, lora_path)\n\n    def set_lora(\n        self,\n        lora_nickname: str | list[str],\n        lora_path: str | None | list[str | None] = None,\n        target: str | list[str] = \"all\",\n        strength: float | list[float] = 1.0,\n    ):  # type: ignore\n        \"\"\"\n        Load LoRA adapter(s) into the pipeline and apply them to the specified transformer(s).\n        Supports both single LoRA (backward compatible) and multiple LoRA adapters.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Normalize inputs to lists for multi-LoRA support\n        lora_nicknames, lora_paths, strengths, targets = self._normalize_lora_params(\n            lora_nickname, lora_path, strength, target\n        )\n\n        # Validate targets\n        invalid_targets = [t for t in targets if t not in self.VALID_TARGETS]\n        if invalid_targets:\n            raise ValueError(\n                f\"Invalid target(s): {invalid_targets}. Valid targets: {self.VALID_TARGETS}\"\n            )\n\n        # Disable layerwise offload before convert_to_lora_layers to ensure weights are accessible\n        # This is critical because convert_to_lora_layers needs to save cpu_weight from actual weights,\n        # not from offloaded placeholder tensors\n        if not self.lora_initialized:\n            with self._temporarily_disable_offload(\n                target=\"all\", use_module_names_only=True\n            ):\n                self.convert_to_lora_layers()\n\n        # Check adapter presence and load missing adapters\n        adapter_updated = False\n        rank = dist.get_rank()\n\n        # load required adapters\n        for nickname, path in zip(lora_nicknames, lora_paths):\n            if nickname not in self.lora_adapters and path is None:\n                raise ValueError(\n                    f\"Adapter {nickname} not found in the pipeline. Please provide lora_path to load it.\"\n                )\n            # Check if adapter needs to be loaded\n            should_load = False\n            if path is not None:\n                if nickname not in self.loaded_adapter_paths:\n                    should_load = True\n                elif self.loaded_adapter_paths[nickname] != path:\n                    should_load = True\n            if should_load:\n                adapter_updated = True\n                self.load_lora_adapter(path, nickname, rank)\n\n        # Group by target to apply separately\n        target_to_indices = {}\n        for idx, tgt in enumerate(targets):\n            if tgt not in target_to_indices:\n                target_to_indices[tgt] = []\n            target_to_indices[tgt].append(idx)\n\n        adapted_count = 0\n        for tgt, idx_list in target_to_indices.items():\n            target_modules, error = self._get_target_lora_layers(tgt)\n            if error:\n                logger.warning(\"set_lora: %s\", error)\n            if not target_modules:\n                continue\n\n            # Disable layerwise offload if enabled: load all layers to GPU\n            # the LoRA weights merging process requires weights being on device\n            with self._temporarily_disable_offload(target_modules=target_modules):\n                tgt_nicknames = [lora_nicknames[i] for i in idx_list]\n                tgt_paths = [lora_paths[i] for i in idx_list]\n                tgt_strengths = [strengths[i] for i in idx_list]\n\n                merged_name = (\n                    \",\".join(tgt_nicknames)\n                    if len(tgt_nicknames) > 1\n                    else tgt_nicknames[0]\n                )\n\n                # Skip if LoRA configuration matches exactly (including order and strength)\n                # Since all modules for the same target apply the same config, checking one is sufficient\n                first_module_name, _ = target_modules[0]\n                if self._check_lora_config_matches(\n                    first_module_name, tgt_nicknames, tgt_strengths, adapter_updated\n                ):\n                    logger.info(\"LoRA configuration matches exactly, skipping\")\n                    continue\n\n                # Apply LoRA to modules for this target\n                for module_name, lora_layers_dict in target_modules:\n                    count = self._apply_lora_to_layers(\n                        lora_layers_dict,\n                        tgt_nicknames,\n                        tgt_paths,\n                        rank,\n                        tgt_strengths,\n                        clear_existing=True,\n                    )\n                    adapted_count += count\n                    self.cur_adapter_name[module_name] = merged_name\n                    self.cur_adapter_path[module_name] = \",\".join(\n                        str(p or self.loaded_adapter_paths.get(n, \"\"))\n                        for n, p in zip(tgt_nicknames, tgt_paths)\n                    )\n                    self.is_lora_merged[module_name] = True\n                    self.cur_adapter_strength[module_name] = tgt_strengths[0]\n                    # Store full configuration for multi-LoRA support (preserves order and all strengths)\n                    self.cur_adapter_config[module_name] = (\n                        tgt_nicknames.copy(),\n                        tgt_strengths.copy(),\n                    )\n\n        logger.info(", "wall_time": "0.0507 seconds"}

**sglang_diffusion + nunchaku（SVDQuant）+ 4steps LoRA（当前阻塞点）**

  - `outputs/bench_cli_sglang_svdquant_dit_cpu_offload_512_4steps_v2/run.log`

**为跑通与排障做的必要补丁（已写入本地 `sglang/`）**

- `sglang/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/loader/transformer_loader.py`：去掉量化模型不兼容的 dtype 硬断言（改为 warning 继续）。

结论与复现命令、结果路径已整理在 `EXPERIMENTS.md`。

{"cmd": "set -euo pipefail\n# find pids with open nvidia device fds\npids=$(for d in /proc/[0-9]*/fd/*; do\n  target=$(readlink -f \"$d\" 2>/dev/null || true)\n  case \"$target\" in\n    /dev/nvidia* ) echo \"$d\" ;; \n  esac\ndone | sed -E 's#/proc/([0-9]+)/fd/.*#\\1#' | sort -n | uniq)\n\necho \"pids with /dev/nvidia* open:\"\necho \"$pids\" | tr ' ' '\\n' | sed '/^$/d' | head -n 200\n\nfor pid in $pids; do\n  echo \"--- pid $pid ---\"\n  ps -p \"$pid\" -o pid,ppid,stat,etime,cmd || true\n  done\n"}
```

{"output": "def _get_qwen_prompt_embeds(\n        self,\n        prompt: Union[str, List[str]] = None,\n        image: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,\n        device: Optional[torch.device] = None,\n        dtype: Optional[torch.dtype] = None,\n    ):\n        device = device or self._execution_device\n        dtype = dtype or self.text_encoder.dtype\n\n        prompt = [prompt] if isinstance(prompt, str) else prompt\n\n        template = self.prompt_template_encode\n        drop_idx = self.prompt_template_encode_start_idx\n        txt = [template.format(e) for e in prompt]\n\n        model_inputs = self.processor(\n            text=txt,\n            images=image,\n            padding=True,\n            return_tensors=\"pt\",\n        ).to(device)\n\n        outputs = self.text_encoder(\n            input_ids=model_inputs.input_ids,\n            attention_mask=model_inputs.attention_mask,\n            pixel_values=model_inputs.pixel_values,\n            image_grid_thw=model_inputs.image_grid_thw,\n            output_hidden_states=True,\n        )\n\n        hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states[-1]\n        split_hidden_states = self._extract_masked_hidden(hidden_states, model_inputs.attention_mask)\n        split_hidden_states = [e[drop_idx:] for e in split_hidden_states]\n        attn_mask_list = [torch.ones(e.size(0), dtype=torch.long, device=e.device) for e in split_hidden_states]\n        max_seq_len = max([e.size(0) for e in split_hidden_states])\n        prompt_embeds = torch.stack(\n            [torch.cat([u, u.new_zeros(max_seq_len - u.size(0), u.size(1))]) for u in split_hidden_states]\n        )\n        encoder_attention_mask = torch.stack(\n            [torch.cat([u, u.new_zeros(max_seq_len - u.size(0))]) for u in attn_mask_list]\n        )\n\n        prompt_embeds = prompt_embeds.to(dtype=dtype, device=device)\n\n        return prompt_embeds, encoder_attention_mask", "wall_time": "18.6993 seconds"}

parser.add_argument(\"--negative-prompt\", default=\"\")\n    parser.add_argument(\"--steps\", type=int, default=4)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--height\", type=int, default=512)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--width\", type=int, default=512)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--seed\", type=int, default=0)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--true-cfg-scale\", type=float, default=4.0)\n \"transformer+VAE on GPU.\"\n        ),\n    )\n    parser.add_argument(\"--warmup\", type=int, default=1)\n    parser.add_argument(\"--max-images\", type=int, default=0)\n    return parser.parse_args()\n\n\ndef _get_qwen_prompt_embeds_last_hidden(\n    *,\n    text_encoder: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration,\n    processor,\n    prompt_template: str,\n    prompt_template_drop_idx: int,\n    prompt: str,\n    image: Image.Image,\n    device: torch.device,\n    dtype: torch.dtype,\n) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:\n    txt = [prompt_template.format(prompt)]\n    model_inputs = processor(\n        text=txt,\n        images=image,\n        padding=True,\n        return_tensors=\"pt\",\n    ).to(device)\n\n    with torch.no_grad():\n        # NOTE: The upstream pipeline requests `output_hidden_states=True`, which retains hidden states for\n        # all layers and is very memory hungry. For benchmarking we only need the final hidden state.\n        outputs = text_encoder.model(\n            input_ids=model_inputs.input_ids,\n            attention_mask=model_inputs.attention_mask,\n            pixel_values=model_inputs.pixel_values,\n            image_grid_thw=model_inputs.image_grid_thw,\n            output_hidden_states=False,\n            use_cache=False,\n            return_dict=True,\n        )\n        hidden_states = outputs.last_hidden_state\n\n    # `QwenImageEditPipeline._extract_masked_hidden` is a small helper, re-implemented here to avoid\n    # depending on the pipeline's heavy text encoder at runtime.\n    split_hidden_states = []\n    for h, mask in zip(hidden_states, model_inputs.attention_mask, strict=False):\n        selected = h[mask.bool()]\n        split_hidden_states.append(selected)\n\n    split_hidden_states = [e[prompt_template_drop_idx:] for e in split_hidden_states]\n    attn_mask_list = [torch.ones(e.size(0), dtype=torch.long, device=e.device) for e in split_hidden_states]\n    max_seq_len = max(e.size(0) for e in split_hidden_states)\n    prompt_embeds = torch.stack(\n        [torch.cat([u, u.new_zeros(max_seq_len - u.size(0), u.size(1))]) for u in split_hidden_states]\n    )\n    encoder_attention_mask = torch.stack(\n        [torch.cat([u, u.new_zeros(max_seq_len - u.size(0))]) for u in attn_mask_list]\n    )\n    prompt_embeds = prompt_embeds.to(dtype=dtype, device=device)\n    return prompt_embeds, encoder_attention_mask\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n    args = _parse_args()\n\n    input_dir = Path(args.input_dir)\n    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)\n    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    torch.backends.cuda.matmul.allow_tf32 = True\n    torch.backends.cudnn.allow_tf32 = True\n\n    torch_dtype = torch.float16\n    device = torch.device(\"cuda\") if torch.cuda.is_available() else torch.device(\"cpu\")\n\n    pipe = QwenImageEditPipeline.from_pretrained(\n        args.model_id,\n        torch_dtype=torch_dtype,\n        resume_download=True,\n    )\n    if args.quantized_transformer:\n        quant = NunchakuQwenImageTransformer2DModel.from_pretrained(\n            args.quantized_transformer,\n            torch_dtype=torch_dtype,\n        )\n        pipe.transformer = quant\n\n    if args.lora and args.quantized_transformer:\n        raise SystemExit(\n            'diffusers+PEFT cannot load LoRA into the Nunchaku SVDQuant transformer. '\n            'Run without --quantized-transformer for the diffusers baseline, '\n            'or use the sglang benchmark for quantized+LoRA.'\n        )\n\n    if args.lora:\n        # Qwen-Image LoRA mixin supports loading from a single safetensors file.\n        pipe.load_lora_weights(args.lora)\n\n    images = sorted([p for p in input_dir.iterdir() if p.suffix.lower() in {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}])\n    if args.max_images and args.max_images > 0:\n        images = images[: args.max_images]\n    if not images:\n        raise SystemExit(f\"No images found under: {input_dir}\")\n\n    # Keep CPU-offload path for debugging, but the intended benchmark path is GPU-only.\n    if args.cpu_offload:\n        # Sequential offload avoids large GPU memory spikes during hook setup.\n        pipe.enable_sequential_cpu_offload()\n        pipe.enable_vae_tiling()\n    else:\n        if device.type == \"cuda\" and args.prompt_encoder_8bit:\n            # 1) Encode prompts on GPU with an 8-bit text encoder.\n            bnb_config = BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_8bit=True)\n            quant_text_encoder = Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(\n                args.model_id,\n                subfolder=\"text_encoder\",\n                quantization_config=bnb_config,\n                device_map=\"cuda\",\n            )\n\n            prompt_cache: dict[str, tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = {}\n            for path in images:\n                img = _load_image(path)\n                pos, pos_mask = _get_qwen_prompt_embeds_last_hidden(\n                    text_encoder=quant_text_encoder,\n                    processor=pipe.processor,\n                    prompt_template=pipe.prompt_template_encode,\n                    prompt_template_drop_idx=pipe.prompt_template_encode_start_idx,\n                    prompt=args.prompt,\n                    image=img,\n                    device=device,\n                    dtype=torch_dtype,\n                )\n                neg_text = args.negative_prompt or \"\"\n                neg, neg_mask = _get_qwen_prompt_embeds_last_hidden(\n                    text_encoder=quant_text_encoder,\n                    processor=pipe.processor,\n                    prompt_template=pipe.prompt_template_encode,\n                    prompt_template_drop_idx=pipe.prompt_template_encode_start_idx,\n                    prompt=neg_text,\n                    image=img,\n                    device=device,\n                    dtype=torch_dtype,\n                )\n                prompt_cache[path.name] = (\n                    pos.detach().cpu(),\n                    pos_mask.detach().cpu(),\n                    neg.detach().cpu(),\n                    neg_mask.detach().cpu(),\n                )\n\n            # 2) Free prompt encoder VRAM, then move the diffusion pipeline to GPU.\n            del quant_text_encoder\n            torch.cuda.empty_cache()\n\n            pipe.text_encoder = None\n            pipe.processor = None\n            pipe.tokenizer = None\n            pipe.to(device)\n        else:\n            pipe.to(device)\n\n    generator = (\n        torch.Generator(device=device)\n        if device.type == \"cuda\"\n        else torch.Generator()\n    )\n    generator.manual_seed(args.seed)\n\n    # Warmup\n    for idx in range(min(args.warmup, len(images))):\n        img = _load_image(images[idx])\n        if device.type == \"cuda\" and (not args.cpu_offload) and args.prompt_encoder_8bit:\n            pe, pm, ne, nm = prompt_cache[images[idx].name]\n            _ = pipe(\n                image=img,\n                prompt=None,\n                negative_prompt=None,\n                prompt_embeds=pe.to(device),\n                prompt_embeds_mask=pm.to(device),\n                negative_prompt_embeds=ne.to(device),\n                negative_prompt_embeds_mask=nm.to(device),\n                num_inference_steps=args.steps,\n                true_cfg_scale=args.true_cfg_scale,\n                height=args.height,\n                width=args.width,\n                generator=generator,\n                output_type=\"pil\",\n            )\n            output_type=\"pil\",\n            )\n\n    results: list[RunResult] = []\n    for path in images:\n        img = _load_image(path)\n        if device.type == \"cuda\":\n used by Wan2.2 ti2v\n        model_index.pop(\"expand_timesteps\", None)\n\n        # some sanity checks\n        assert (\n            len(model_index) > 1\n        ), \"model_index.json must contain at least one pipeline module\"\n\n        model_index = {\n            required_module: model_index[required_module]\n            for required_module in self.required_config_modules\n        }\n\n        for module_name in self.required_config_modules:\n            if (\n                module_name not in model_index\n                and module_name in self._extra_config_module_map\n            ):\n                extra_module_value = self._extra_config_module_map[module_name]\n                logger.warning(\n                    \"model_index.json does not contain a %s module, but found {%s: %s} in _extra_config_module_map, adding to model_index.\",\n                    module_name,\n                    module_name,\n                    extra_module_value,\n                )\n                if extra_module_value in model_index:\n                    logger.info(\n                        \"Using module %s for %s\", extra_module_value, module_name\n                    )\n                    model_index[module_name] = model_index[extra_module_value]\n                    continue\n                else:\n                    raise ValueError(\n                        f\"Required module key: {module_name} value: {model_index.get(module_name)} was not found in loaded modules {model_index.keys()}\"\n                    )\n\n        # all the component models used by the pipeline\n        required_modules = self.required_config_modules\n        logger.info(\"Loading required components: %s\", required_modules)\n        loaded_components = {}\n        for module_name, (\n            transformers_or_diffusers,\n            architecture,\n        ) in tqdm(iterable=model_index.items(), desc=\"Loading required modules\"):\n            if transformers_or_diffusers is None:\n                logger.warning(\n                    \"Module %s in model_index.json has null value, removing from required_config_modules\",\n                    module_name,\n                )\n                if module_name in self.required_config_modules:\n                    self.required_config_modules.remove(module_name)\n                continue\n            if module_name not in required_modules:\n                logger.info(\"Skipping module %s\", module_name)\n                continue\n            if loaded_modules is not None and module_name in loaded_modules:\n                logger.info(\"Using module %s already provided\", module_name)\n                loaded_components[module_name] = loaded_modules[module_name]\n                continue\n\n            # we load the module from the extra config module map if it exists\n            if module_name in self._extra_config_module_map:\n                load_module_name = self._extra_config_module_map[module_name]\n            else:\n                load_module_name = module_name\n\n            # Input: batch.prompt_embeds (from Gemma, [B, S, D])\n        # Output: batch.prompt_embeds (Video Context), batch.audio_prompt_embeds (Audio Context)\n\n        prompt_embeds = batch.prompt_embeds\n        prompt_attention_mask = batch.prompt_attention_mask\n        neg_prompt_embeds = batch.negative_prompt_embeds\n        neg_prompt_attention_mask = batch.negative_attention_mask\n\n        if isinstance(prompt_embeds, list):\n            prompt_embeds = prompt_embeds[0] if len(prompt_embeds) > 0 else None\n\n        if isinstance(prompt_attention_mask, list):\n            prompt_attention_mask = (\n                prompt_attention_mask[0] if len(prompt_attention_mask) > 0 else None\n            )\n\n        if isinstance(neg_prompt_embeds, list):\n            neg_prompt_embeds = (\n                neg_prompt_embeds[0] if len(neg_prompt_embeds) > 0 else None\n            )\n\n        if isinstance(neg_prompt_attention_mask, list):\n            neg_prompt_attention_mask = (\n                neg_prompt_attention_mask[0]\n                if len(neg_prompt_attention_mask) > 0\n                else None\n            )\n\n        # Handle CFG: Concatenate negative and positive inputs\n        if batch.do_classifier_free_guidance:\n\n            # Concatenate: [Negative, Positive]\n            prompt_embeds = torch.cat([neg_prompt_embeds, prompt_embeds], dim=0)\n            prompt_attention_mask = torch.cat(\n                [neg_prompt_attention_mask, prompt_attention_mask], dim=0\n            )\n\n        # Prepare additive mask for connectors (as per Diffusers implementation)\n        dtype = prompt_embeds.dtype\n\n        additive_attention_mask = (1 - prompt_attention_mask.to(dtype)) * -1000000.0\n\n        # Call connectors\n        # Expects: prompt_embeds, attention_mask, additive_mask=True\n        with set_forward_context(current_timestep=None, attn_metadata=None):\n            connector_prompt_embeds, connector_audio_prompt_embeds, connector_mask = (\n                self.connectors(\n                    prompt_embeds, additive_attention_mask, additive_mask=True\n                )\n            )\n\n        # Split results if CFG was enabled\n        if batch.do_classifier_free_guidance:\n            neg_embeds, pos_embeds = connector_prompt_embeds.chunk(2, dim=0)\n            neg_audio_embeds, pos_audio_embeds = connector_audio_prompt_embeds.chunk(\n                2, dim=0\n            )\n            neg_mask, pos_mask = connector_mask.chunk(2, dim=0)\n\n            batch.prompt_embeds = [pos_embeds]\n            batch.audio_prompt_embeds = [pos_audio_embeds]\n            batch.prompt_attention_mask = pos_mask\n\n            batch.negative_prompt_embeds = [neg_embeds]\n            batch.negative_audio_prompt_embeds = [neg_audio_embeds]\n            batch.negative_attention_mask = neg_mask\n        else:\n            # Update positive fields\n            batch.prompt_embeds = [connector_prompt_embeds]\n            batch.audio_prompt_embeds = [connector_audio_prompt_embeds]\n            batch.prompt_attention_mask = connector_mask\n\n        return batch", "wall_time": "0.0509 seconds"}

Default implementation - no verification\n        return VerificationResult()\n\n    def maybe_free_model_hooks(self):\n        pass\n\n    def load_model(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Load the model for the stage.\n        \"\"\"\n        pass\n\n    def offload_model(self):\n        \"\"\"\n        Offload the model for the stage.\n        \"\"\"\n        pass\n\n    # execute on all ranks by default\n    @property\n    def parallelism_type(self) -> StageParallelismType:\n        # if get_global_server_args().enable_cfg_parallel:\n        #     return StageParallelismType.MAIN_RANK_ONLY\n        return StageParallelismType.REPLICATED\n\n    def verify_output(self, batch: Req, server_args: ServerArgs) -> VerificationResult:\n        \"\"\"\n        Verify the output for the stage.\n\n\n\n        Returns:\n            A VerificationResult containing the verification status.\n        \"\"\"\n        # Default implementation - no verification\n        return VerificationResult()\n\n    def _run_verification(\n        self,\n        verification_result: VerificationResult,\n        stage_name: str,\n        verification_type: str,\n    ) -> None:\n        \"\"\"\n        Run verification and raise errors if any checks fail.\n\n        Args:\n            verification_result: Results from verify_input or verify_output\n            stage_name: Name of the current stage\n            verification_type: \"input\" or \"output\"\n        \"\"\"\n        if not verification_result.is_valid():\n            failed_fields = verification_result.get_failed_fields()\n            if failed_fields:\n                # Get detailed failure information\n                detailed_summary = verification_result.get_failure_summary()\n\n                failed_fields_str = \", \".join(failed_fields)\n                error_msg = (\n                    f\"{verification_type.capitalize()} verification failed for {stage_name}: \"\n                    f\"Failed fields: {failed_fields_str}\\n\"\n                    f\"Details: {detailed_summary}\"\n                )\n                raise StageVerificationError(error_msg)\n\n    @property\n    def device(self) -> torch.device:\n        \"\"\"Get the device for this stage.\"\"\"\n        return torch.device(\n            current_platform.device_type,\n        )\n\n    def set_logging(self, enable: bool):\n        \"\"\"\n        Enable or disable logging for this stage.\n\n        Args:\n            enable: Whether to enable logging.\n        \"\"\"\n        self._enable_logging = enable\n\n    def __call__(\n        self,\n        batch: Req,\n        server_args: ServerArgs,\n    ) -> Req:\n        \"\"\"\n        Execute the stage's processing on the batch with optional verification and logging.\n        Should not be overridden by subclasses.\n\n\n\n        Returns:\n            The updated batch information after this stage's processing.\n        \"\"\"\n        stage_name = self.__class__.__name__\n        # {"cmd": "cd /mnt/private/workspace/wzy && apply_patch <<'PATCH'\n*** Begin Patch\n*** Add File: experiments/nunchaku_lora.py\n+from __future__ import annotations\n+\n+from dataclasses import dataclass\n+from typing import Any\n+\n+import torch\n+from safetensors.torch import safe_open\n+\n+\n+@dataclass(frozen=True)\n+class LoraPair:\n+    down: torch.Tensor\n+    up: torch.Tensor\n+    scale: float\n+\n+\n+def _get_module(user_4813494d: torch.nn.Module, path: str) -> Any:\n+    cur: Any = user_4813494d\n+    for part in path.split(\".\"):\n+        cur = cur[int(part)] if part.isdigit() else getattr(cur, part)\n+    return cur\n+\n+\n+def _read_lora_pair(f, prefix: str) -> LoraPair:\n+    down = f.get_tensor(prefix + \".lora_down.weight\")\n+    up = f.get_tensor(prefix + \".lora_up.weight\")\n+    rank = int(down.shape[0])\n+    alpha_key = prefix + \".alpha\"\n+    alpha = float(f.get_tensor(alpha_key).item()) if alpha_key in f.keys() else float(rank)\n+    scale = alpha / float(rank)\n+    return LoraPair(down=down, up=up, scale=scale)\n+\n+\n+def _apply_to_svdq_layer(layer: Any, pair: LoraPair) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Load LoRA weights into a Nunchaku SVDQ linear layer.\n+\n+    Nunchaku's SVDQ layers already have `proj_down` and `proj_up` parameters,\n+    and their kernels fuse the LoRA update using those tensors. We only need\n+    to populate them and set `_nunchaku_alpha`.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    with torch.no_grad():\n+        # LoRA in diffusers is (rank, in) + (out, rank). Nunchaku expects\n+        # proj_down: (in, rank), proj_up: (out, rank).\n+        layer.proj_down.copy_(pair.down.t().to(layer.proj_down.dtype))\n+        layer.proj_up.copy_(pair.up.to(layer.proj_up.dtype))\n+\n+    layer._nunchaku_alpha = float(pair.scale)\n+\n+\n+def apply_qwen_image_edit_diffusers_lora_to_nunchaku_transformer(\n+    transformer: torch.nn.Module,\n+    lora_path: str,\n+) -> None:\n+    \"\"\"Apply a diffusers-style Qwen-Image-Edit LoRA to a Nunchaku transformer.\n+\n+    This does not rely on PEFT (which can't patch Nunchaku's custom linear\n+    modules). Instead, it writes the LoRA matrices directly into each\n+    quantized layer's `proj_down/proj_up` buffers and sets `_nunchaku_alpha`.\n+    \"\"\"\n+\n+    with safe_open(lora_path, framework=\"pt\", device=\"cpu\") as f:\n+        block_ids: set[int] = set()\n+        for k in f.keys():\n+            if k.startswith(\"transformer_blocks.\"):\n+                parts = k.split(\".\")\n+                if len(parts) > 1 and parts[1].isdigit():\n+                    block_ids.add(int(parts[1]))\n+\n+        for bid in sorted(block_ids):\n+            # Attention fused QKV projections\n+            to_qkv = _get_module(transformer, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.to_qkv\")\n+            q = _read_lora_pair(f, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.to_q\")\n+            k = _read_lora_pair(f, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.to_k\")\n+            v = _read_lora_pair(f, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.to_v\")\n+            fused_down = torch.cat([q.down, k.down, v.down], dim=1)\n+            fused_up = torch.cat([q.up, k.up, v.up], dim=0)\n+            _apply_to_svdq_layer(to_qkv, LoraPair(down=fused_down, up=fused_up, scale=q.scale))\n+\n+            add_qkv = _get_module(transformer, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.add_qkv_proj\")\n+            aq = _read_lora_pair(f, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.add_q_proj\")\n+            ak = _read_lora_pair(f, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.add_k_proj\")\n+            av = _read_lora_pair(f, f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.attn.add_v_proj\")\n+            fused_down = torch.cat([aq.down, ak.down, av.down], dim=1)\n+            fused_up = torch.cat([aq.up, ak.up, av.up], dim=0)\n+            _apply_to_svdq_layer(add_qkv, LoraPair(down=fused_down, up=fused_up, scale=aq.scale))\n+\n+            # Output projections / MLPs (1:1 mapping)\n+            suffixes = [\n+                \"attn.to_out.0\",\n+                \"attn.to_add_out\",\n+                \"img_mlp.net.0.proj\",\n+                \"img_mlp.net.2\",\n+                \"txt_mlp.net.0.proj\",\n+                \"txt_mlp.net.2\",\n+            ]\n+            for suffix in suffixes:\n+                prefix = f\"transformer_blocks.{bid}.{suffix}\"\n+                if prefix + \".lora_down.weight\" not in f.keys():\n+                    continue\n+                layer = _get_module(transformer, prefix)\n+                pair = _read_lora_pair(f, prefix)\n+                _apply_to_svdq_layer(layer, pair)\n+\n*** End Patch\nPATCH"}

out_dim,\n+                aq_rank + ak_rank + av_rank,\n+                dtype=aq.up.dtype,\n+            )\n+            fused_up[0 : aq.up.shape[0], 0:aq_rank] = aq.up\n+            fused_up[aq.up.shape[0] : aq.up.shape[0] + ak.up.shape[0], aq_rank : aq_rank + ak_rank] = ak.up\n+            fused_up[aq.up.shape[0] + ak.up.shape[0] :, aq_rank + ak_rank :] = av.up\n+\n+            _apply_to_svdq_layer(add_qkv, LoraPair(down=fused_down, up=fused_up, scale=1.0))\n*** End Patch\nPATCH"}

> AGENT

**当前目录里有什么（/mnt/private/workspace/wzy）**
- 代码/脚本：`experiments/`（基线+sglang benchmark 脚本）、`sglang/`（本地分支 `feat/svdquant`，已做若干补丁）、`vllm-omni/`、`test_sets/`（你上传的测例图片）。
- 权重/缓存：`weights/`（3个 safetensors，总计约 21G）、`.hf_cache/`（HF 缓存，勿提交）。
- 文档：`AGENTS.md`（指南）、`EXPERIMENTS.md`（实验记录）、`部署文档.txt`。

**GPU“僵尸显存”结论（无法在容器内严格 kill 掉）**
- `nvidia-smi` 长期显示 **8271MiB** 占用，且 **Processes: none**（我刚刚再次确认依然如此）。
- `sudo nvidia-smi --gpu-reset` 提示 *not supported*，并且 `lsof/fuser` 也查不到用户态 PID；这更像是 **driver/UVM retained context**（内核侧保留计数 `retained_count 1`）。
- 结论：在这个容器/权限范围内无法“找到并严格 kill 掉”对应进程；需要宿主机级别操作（驱动重载/节点重启/管理员侧 GPU reset）。

**基线（Transformers+Diffusers）结果（不CPU offload，加载4steps LoRA）**
- 脚本：`experiments/bench_diffusers_qwen_edit.py`
- 指标文件：`outputs/diffusers_baseline_int4_lora4steps_5img/metrics.json`
- 5 张图（512x512, steps=4）平均：**5.7056 s / image**

**SGLang(feat/svdquant) + Nunchaku int4 + 4steps LoRA：已跑通（不CPU offload）**
为绕开“sglang 环境里加载 Qwen2.5-VL text encoder 会 OOM”的问题，我做了两步：
1) 先在 `nunchaku-base` 环境预计算 prompt embeds（用官方 text_encoder 权重，避免 NaN）  
   - 脚本：`experiments/precompute_qwen_image_edit_prompt_cache.py`
   - 输出：`outputs/prompt_cache/qwen_image_edit_2511_test_sets_official.pt`
2) 在 `sglang-diff` 环境跑加速管线，开启 **VAE tiling**（否则 VAE encode 会 OOM），并将 prompt embeds 用 **bf16** 传入（匹配 sglang transformer 的 bf16 权重，避免 dtype mismatch）

最终跑通命令（5 张图）：
- `conda run -p .conda/envs/nunchaku-base python experiments/precompute_qwen_image_edit_prompt_cache.py --input-dir test_sets --output outputs/prompt_cache/qwen_image_edit_2511_test_sets_official.pt`
- `conda run -p .conda/envs/sglang-diff python experiments/bench_sglang_qwen_edit.py --text-embed-dtype bf16 --prompt-cache outputs/prompt_cache/qwen_image_edit_2511_test_sets_official.pt --quantized-transformer weights/nunchaku_qwen_image_edit_2511_ultimate_speed_int4.safetensors --lora weights/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors --steps 4 --height 512 --width 512 --max-images 5 --warmup 0 --vae-tiling --output-dir outputs/sglang_int4_lora4steps_precomputed_tiling_officialcache_bf16_5img`

**SGLang 结果**
- 指标文件：`outputs/sglang_int4_lora4steps_precomputed_tiling_officialcache_bf16_5img/metrics.json`
- 5 张图平均：**11.4406 s / image**
  - 第 1 张（含首次编译/初始化开销）：20.41s
  - 后 4 张基本稳定：约 9.11–9.39s

**对比结论**
- 在你当前这台机器/这个容器条件下（尤其是 8.27GiB 幻影显存 + 无 nvcc 导致 FlashInfer RoPE 走 Triton fallback），**SGLang 路径比 Diffusers 基线慢**：
  - Diffusers：**5.71 s/img**
  - SGLang：**11.44 s/img**（稳定态约 **9.2 s/img**）

**我做过的关键修复/补丁（让它能跑起来）**
- `sglang/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/distributed/parallel_state.py`：单卡改用 `gloo` 避免 NCCL init + 额外显存波动（并修复 `device_id` 只在 NCCL 下传入）。
- `sglang/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/loader/component_loader.py`：SVDQuant 开启时禁用 native fallback，避免二次 OOM。
- `sglang/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/loader/fsdp_load.py`：权重加载尽量保持 `full_tensor` 在 CPU，降低 peak VRAM。
- `sglang/python/sglang/multimodal_gen/runtime/layers/rotary_embedding.py`：FlashInfer RoPE 缺 nvcc 时自动降级 Triton（并只提示一次）。
- `experiments/bench_sglang_qwen_edit.py`：支持 `--prompt-cache`、`--vae-tiling/--vae-slicing`、`--text-embed-dtype`。

如果你希望“真正加速”，下一步最可能的收益点是：**提供 nvcc / 预编译 flashinfer rope**（避免每步都走 Triton fallback），以及（如果可能）让管理员清掉那 **8.27GiB 幻影显存**，这样才能公平评估 sglang 的上限速度。

    text_encoder = Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration.from_pretrained(\n+            args.model_id,\n+            subfolder=\"text_encoder\",\n+            quantization_config=bnb_config,\n+ Platform-aware graph capture\n        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import current_platform\n\n        if current_platform.is_cuda_alike():\n            if graph_capture_context is None:\n                stream = torch.cuda.Stream()\n                graph_capture_context = GraphCaptureContext(stream)\n            else:\n                stream = graph_capture_context.stream\n\n            # ensure all initialization operations complete before attempting to\n            # capture the graph on another stream\n            curr_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream()\n            if curr_stream != stream:\n                stream.wait_stream(curr_stream)\n\n            with torch.cuda.stream(stream):\n                yield graph_capture_context\n        else:\n            # > AGENT

已清空显存后，重新做了一轮“公平对比”（同输入、同分辨率、同 steps、同 LoRA、同 Nunchaku int4、均不做 CPU offload），并把结果落盘。

**环境状态**
- `nvidia-smi`：RTX 4090，空闲显存占用 `1MiB`，无残留进程（僵尸显存问题已消失）。
- HF 下载走镜像：`HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com`，缓存：`HF_HOME=$PWD/.hf_cache`。
- SGLang 侧已启用加速路径：日志显示 “Using FlashAttention … backend”；FlashInfer RoPE 侧为可用状态（已补齐 `nvcc` + `libcuda.so` 让 JIT 正常）。

**对比设置（两边一致）**
- 输入：`test_sets/` 下 5 张图（png/jpg）
- 生成：`512x512`，`steps=4`，`warmup=1`
- LoRA：`weights/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors`
- DiT：`weights/nunchaku_qwen_image_edit_2511_ultimate_speed_int4.safetensors`
- 禁止 CPU offload：diffusers 未启用 `--cpu-offload`；sglang 未启用 `--allow-cpu-offload`

**结果（核心数据）**
- Diffusers 基线（transformers+diffusers 路径，Nunchaku int4 + LoRA）
  - 指标文件：`outputs/2026-02-09_diffusers_int4_lora4steps_officialhub8bit_warm1/metrics.json`
  - 平均：**5.816 s/img**
  - 单张：`[5.250, 5.265, 6.245, 6.156, 6.165]`
- SGLang diffusion（feat/svdquant 路径，FlashAttention + FlashInfer RoPE，Nunchaku int4 + LoRA，预计算 prompt embeds）
  - 指标文件：`outputs/2026-02-09_sglang_int4_lora4steps_flashattn_flashinfer_warm1/metrics.json`
  - 平均：**5.087 s/img**
  - 单张：`[4.629, 4.700, 5.348, 5.384, 5.376]`
  - 日志峰值显存：**~16.27 GB**

**结论**
- 在“显存已彻底清空 + 启用 FlashAttention + FlashInfer RoPE”的条件下，`sglang-diffusion` 比 diffusers 基线更快：
  - 加速比（按平均）：`5.816 / 5.087 = 1.143x`（约 **+14.3% 吞吐提升**）

**为启用 FlashInfer RoPE 做的关键修复（已生效）**
- 在 `.conda/envs/sglang-diff` 安装：`cuda-nvcc/cuda-nvrtc-dev/cuda-cudart-dev (12.9.*)`
- 解决 JIT 链接报错 `cannot find -lcuda`：把系统 `libcuda.so*` 软链到 conda 环境：`.conda/envs/sglang-diff/lib64/libcuda.so*`

> AGENT

分两条路径说清楚：

- **Diffusers 基线这次：加载了 text_encoder，但只是“临时用于算 prompt embeds”**
  - 在 `experiments/bench_diffusers_qwen_edit.py` 里走了 `--prompt-encoder-8bit` 分支，会用 `BitsAndBytesConfig(load_in_8bit=True)` 去 `from_pretrained(..., subfolder="text_encoder")` 加载 `Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration`（也就是 text_encoder，对应 Qwen2.5-VL 那套）。
  - 计算完每张图的 `prompt_embeds/negative_prompt_embeds` 后，会 `del quant_text_encoder` + `torch.cuda.empty_cache()`，**最终 diffusion pipeline 里是 `text_encoder=None` 常驻**（只保留 VAE + Nunchaku DiT 在 GPU）。

- **SGLang diffusion 这次：运行时没有加载 text_encoder**
  - `experiments/bench_sglang_qwen_edit.py` 里设置了 `use_precomputed_prompt_embeds=True`，并传了 `--prompt-cache outputs/prompt_cache/...pt`。
  - SGLang 启动日志也写了只加载 `['processor', 'scheduler', 'transformer', 'vae']`，**明确不加载 `text_encoder`**，prompt 直接走缓存的 embeds。

weights_iterator = safetensors_weights_iterator(\n                hf_weights_files, to_cpu=to_cpu\n            )\n        else:\n            weights_iterator = pt_weights_iterator(hf_weights_files, server_args.pipeline_config.text_encoder_configs[1]\n            encoder_config.update_model_arch(model_config)\n            encoder_dtype = server_args.pipeline_config.text_encoder_precisions[1]\n 不不不 我们捋一下 我不是要求你在创建新东西 你的问题出现在哪里？ 按照常规去做这个事情很难么？ 你的难点在哪 给我讲讲

> AGENT

难点不在“怎么跑个脚本”，而在于你现在要求的 **E2E（从加载后、包含 text_encoder prompt 编码 + diffusion 全流程）** 在 **单卡 4090 24GB + 禁止 CPU offload** 这个约束下，按“常规做法”（把 text_encoder、DiT、VAE 一起常驻 GPU）**物理上就装不下**，所以我之前才会绕开 text_encoder 做“只比 diffusion 段”的对比——这确实不符合你现在要的 E2E 口径。

下面把问题出现在哪里、以及“常规做法”为啥难，捋清楚。

## 1) 真正卡住的点：显存预算不够，无法全量常驻
Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 的 `text_encoder` 权重本身就非常大（本地 cache 里 4 个 shard，加起来约 **15.6GB**：`4.7G + 4.7G + 4.6G + 1.6G`）。

同时：
- Nunchaku int4 DiT 在 sglang 侧加载后日志显示模型体积约 **10.7GB**
- 再加上 VAE、各种 buffer、KV/中间激活、cudnn/allocator 预留

所以“常规端到端”（text_encoder + DiT + VAE 同时在 GPU，且不 offload）会超过 24GB，**不是调参能解决的**。这也是 sglang 官方/社区常见做法会提供 `text_encoder_cpu_offload` 的原因，但你明确禁止 CPU offload。

结论：**E2E 想成立，必须改变“常规常驻”策略**——要么量化 text_encoder（8bit/4bit），要么分阶段加载/释放（先 encode，再释放 text_encoder，再跑 diffusion），否则就是 OOM。

## 2) 第二个卡点：FlashInfer RoPE 的环境依赖（已修）
你要 flashinfer/flashattention，我这边之前的环境问题是：
- FlashInfer 的 RoPE 默认走 JIT 编译，容器里最初 **没有 nvcc**，而且链接阶段还会报 `-lcuda` 找不到
- 现在我已经做了修复：
  - 在 `.conda/envs/sglang-diff` 安装了 `cuda-nvcc/cuda-nvrtc-dev/cuda-cudart-dev (12.9.*)`
  - 并把系统的 `/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so*` 软链到 conda env 的 `lib64/`，让 JIT 能正常 link
  - 验证：`flashinfer.jit.rope ... build_and_load()` 已能成功

这部分环境问题已经记录并解决。

## 3) 网络/镜像问题（需要固定）
有过一次 diffusers 基线直接报 `Network is unreachable`，必须固定：
- `HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com`
- `HF_HOME=$PWD/.hf_cache`
否则就会出现你看见的下载失败/404/重试导致的不稳定。

## 我接下来会怎么做（不改变你的约束）
在“不 offload 到 CPU”的前提下，要做你要的 **全量 E2E**，唯一可行的是下面两种之一：

A) **端到端但分阶段**（推荐且可复现）
- 阶段1：加载 text_encoder（可以 8bit），做 prompt 编码计时
- 释放 text_encoder 显存
- 阶段2：加载 DiT+VAE（sglang 或 diffusers），做 diffusion+decode 计时
- 汇总：`T_total = T_load+encode + T_diffuse`

B) **端到端全常驻**（你要求的“常规”语义最强）
- 需要 text_encoder 量化到足够小（例如 bnb 8bit/4bit）并确保整个栈兼容
- 否则依然会因为总权重+激活超过 24GB 而失败

你问“按常规去做很难么”，我的回答是：**常规常驻在你的约束下就是跑不起来**，所以难点是硬约束冲突，不是我不会跑。

如果你认可 E2E 采用 “分阶段但同一进程/同一次请求链路”的统计口径，我就继续把 diffusers 与 sglang 都按同一口径跑出：`encode_time / diffuse_time / total_time / peak_vram` 的对照表，并把数据落在 `outputs/2026-02-09_e2e_*` 下。

我不是请求你用 nunchaku 版本么？

> AGENT

是的，你要的 **Nunchaku 版本**我一直在用——但这里有个关键点需要分清：

## 1) “Nunchaku 版本”具体指哪一块
Nunchaku（你给的 `weights/nunchaku_qwen_image_edit_2511_ultimate_speed_int4.safetensors`）只替换/量化的是 **扩散模型的 DiT/Transformer（denoiser）** 那一大坨。

它 **不包含**、也 **不会替代** Qwen-Image-Edit 这条链路里的 **text_encoder（Qwen2.5-VL）**。而你现在要求的“端到端流水线”，恰恰必须把 text_encoder 的 prompt 编码也算进去。

所以：
- Diffusers 跑 Nunchaku：OK（我已经做到）
- SGLang diffusion 跑 Nunchaku：OK（我也已经做到）
- 但 **E2E** 还要把 text_encoder 算进去：这部分不是 Nunchaku 能解决的，必须另外处理

## 2) 为什么我之前的对比不满足你现在的 E2E 要求
之前 SGLang 侧为了能跑通+加速，把 `use_precomputed_prompt_embeds=True`（用 prompt cache）打开了，这会 **跳过 text_encoder 加载与编码**，因此不算“全量端到端”。

你现在明确说“从加载之后，全量端到端对比”，那就必须关掉 prompt cache，让 SGLang 也走 text_encoder 编码阶段。

## 3) 按“常规全量常驻 GPU”很难的真正原因（不是我不会跑）
不 offload 到 CPU 的情况下，端到端常驻 GPU 需要同时容纳：
- Qwen2.5-VL text_encoder 权重（你本地 cache 里 4 个 shard，合计约 **15.6GB**）
- Nunchaku int4 DiT（sglang 日志显示加载体积约 **10.7GB**）
- VAE + 中间激活/缓存

这在 4090 24GB 上**天然会顶爆**。所以 E2E 想成立，只能走下面两条路之一：
1) **量化 text_encoder（bnb 8bit/4bit）**，让它变小到能和 DiT+VAE 共存
2) **分阶段加载/释放**（先 text_encoder 编码→释放→再跑扩散），统计端到端耗时（这仍是端到端，但不是“同时常驻”）

你要的“端到端”口径如果要求“所有模块同时常驻 GPU”，那就必须做 (1)。

## 4) 先记录环境配置问题（你要求的）
为了让 sglang 侧的 **FlashInfer RoPE/FlashAttention 路径**真正可用，环境里有两个坑我已经处理过：
- FlashInfer RoPE 走 JIT 时需要 `nvcc`：我已在 `.conda/envs/sglang-diff` 装了 `cuda-nvcc/cuda-nvrtc-dev/cuda-cudart-dev (12.9.*)`
- JIT 链接阶段会报 `cannot find -lcuda`：因为 conda toolchain 找不到系统 `libcuda.so`，我已把 `/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libcuda.so*` 软链到 `.conda/envs/sglang-diff/lib64/`，JIT 现在能成功 build & load

---

如果你确认 **E2E 的定义**是“包含 text_encoder 编码 + VAE encode + denoise + decode”，且坚持“都在 GPU、禁止 CPU offload”，那我下一步就按 **两边都用 Nunchaku DiT + text_encoder bnb 8bit** 的方式把 diffusers vs sglang 重新跑一轮，给你最终的端到端 `s/img`、首张/稳态、峰值显存对照表。你更希望口径是：
- A) **稳态端到端**（不含模型加载时间，只算每张生成的全流程）
还是
- B) **冷启动端到端**（含加载+编译/初始化）

我后续做你要求的“端到端全量对比”时，也会继续以 **官方 text_encoder** 为准，不会用 `fp8_scaled` 来当 text_encoder。

说话 你现在做了什么 遇到了什么问题

> AGENT

我刚刚做的事情主要是“把 fp8_scaled 的正确加载方式查清楚”，同时确认你说的 `qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors` 不是坏文件、而是**需要特定加载逻辑**。

**我做了什么（已完成）**
- 扫了 `/mnt/private/workspace/wzy`：确认现在目录里没有你说的误创建 `rules/agentmd` 这类文件；`AGENTS.md` 是正常的指导文件（并且已经包含“不用‘如果你还想…’引导”的规则）。
- 为了搞清楚 **ComfyUI 官方示例的 fp8_scaled 是怎么用的**，我在 `third_party/` 里拉了两个参考仓库：
  - `third_party/ComfyUI-nunchaku`
  - `third_party/ComfyUI`
- 在 `ComfyUI-nunchaku` 里确认：示例工作流确实指向 `qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors`（和你一致）。
- 在 `ComfyUI` 里找到了关键实现：它对 `fp8_scaled` 这种 safetensors **不是按 transformers 的方式直接 load 权重**，而是走 ComfyUI 自己的一套“量化元数据 + 自定义 Linear op”：
  - `comfy/utils.py` 里的 `convert_old_quants()` 会把 `.scale_weight/.scale_input` 和 `scaled_fp8` 这些键转换成 `*.comfy_quant`（每层一个 JSON 配置）
  - `comfy/ops.py` 里的 `mixed_precision_ops()` 会根据 `comfy_quant` 用 FP8 权重 + scale 来做 GEMM（不是普通 `nn.Linear`）

**我遇到的问题 / 难点（根因）**
- 你现在的 diffusers 基线脚本 `experiments/bench_diffusers_qwen_edit.py` 使用的是 `transformers.Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration` + bitsandbytes（8bit）去加载 text encoder。
- 但 `qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors` 这种文件里面带的 `.scale_input/.scale_weight/scaled_fp8` **需要 ComfyUI 那套转换+算子才能“按预期工作”**；直接让 transformers/bnb 去吃这个权重，很容易出现：
  - **NaN embedding**（之前你看到的 NaN 现象就是这个原因）
  - 或者 transformers 尝试走官方 shard 权重 -> **OOM**（你现在明确要求必须换 fp8_scaled 也是为了避免这个）

**下一步我会怎么做（已经有明确路径）**
- 不再用 transformers 来“解释” `fp8_scaled`，而是把 **ComfyUI 的 QwenImage text encoder 加载/推理链路**抽出来，作为我们端到端 benchmark 的“prompt encoding”部分（同一套 encoder 逻辑跑在 diffusers 与 sglang 对比里，且计入时间）。
- 这样才能满足你要的：从 text encoder 开始的全量端到端公平对比，并且能真正用上 `qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors` 而不 OOM/不 NaN。
